title: Postdoctoral Fellowship
about: Postdoctoral research fellowships at the Science History Institute for 2027-2028. The application deadline is 15 January 2027, referee letters are due 31 January and decisions are sent by 15 April. Applicants must be on track to defend their dissertation by end of July 2027.
requirements: Dissertation defended by the end of July 2027
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Postdoctoral Fellowship at the Science History Institute in Philadelphia, United States, deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty in front of the Manhattan skyline and Empire State Building in New York, not Philadelphia.
